body.escapeReason: realm-reward replay/reconcile seams read the persisted way record and re-executed dormant grants; the contract describes dormancy as inert-but-preserved, so seams must gate BEFORE reading the record | detector gap: restore-path probes only covered a dormant FEATURE save, not a dormant WAY save
applicability: restore/reconcile/realm-transition seams that read persisted scope-hidden records
proposedProtection: assert inactive-way saves mint zero realmRewards nodes/passives on reconcile+grant+realm-advance; enumerate every seam that re-reads a preserved dormant record

body.escapeReason: a beta-live consumer derived its only upstream from a scope-hidden system -> the whole visible loop was dead on legal saves | detector gap: the dormant-field census checked for leaks FROM dormant state, not for live features DEPENDING on dormant state
applicability: any beta surface whose single upstream is a scope-hidden producer
proposedProtection: for each scope-hidden producer, census live consumers and give the consumer a legal fallback (flat beta value), not just a gate

body.escapeReason: persisted dormant records overrode live beta values (worker capacity, job-slot budget) - dormancy read through carried state instead of being ignored | detector gap: hostile-save probes covered dormant FIELDS but not dormant RECORDS inside live aggregates
applicability: aggregates that mix live + scope-hidden records (capacity pools, job slots)
proposedProtection: when a scope-hidden slice is preserved, every aggregate that iterates it must filter by the admission predicate, not by presence

body.escapeReason: render surfaces mounted dormant blocks (allocation UI, toast identity, extra-source binding) on flagged saves without consulting the scope verdict | Low/Nit deferred per ruling
applicability: panel/notification surfaces that bind raw persisted records
proposedProtection: gate dormant-slice render blocks on betaSurfaceVisible; surfaces may not name dormant identities

body.escapeReason: talent effect lookup resolved any catalog id - a talent whose ONLY acquisition path is excluded still emitted effects on carried saves | detector gap: the rosters existed for ways/features but no talent roster existed; effect emitter had no admission check
applicability: every effect emitter that resolves a catalog id from persisted state
proposedProtection: beta admission rosters must cover every persisted id-space that an effect emitter can resolve (ways, features, talents, recipes, nodes)

body.escapeReason: registry.get() throwing on unknown ids sat behind a !==undefined guard that could never fail - validator-tolerated ghost ids crashed the respec UI | detector gap: save-shape validation tolerates foreign ids but no probe crossed a tolerated id into a live op
applicability: any code that probes the NodeRegistry (or other throwing registries) from persisted ids
proposedProtection: use has() before get() on every throwing registry probed from save data; fuzz each tolerated-but-foreign persisted field through the ops that read it

body.escapeReason: write-only dormant mint, capability-bridge HUD render, dev-only reset refund and a latent ungated grant seam - all Low/Nit, deferred per the Medium+-only ruling
applicability: dormant-way saves, capability-gated HUD bridges, devtool ops
proposedProtection: next scope revision should still pin write-only mints + capability bridges; latent seams get admission predicates when they gain dormant inputs
